Name: Minecraft Paintings in Stardew Valley
Author: mrhacwer
Description:
[size=3]Are you a fan of both [b]Minecraft[/b] and [b]Stardew Valley[/b]?

This mod bridges the gap between these two beloved games by bringing the iconic 
[b]Minecraft [/b]paintings into the charming world of [b]Stardew Valley[/b]!

[/size][size=3]The mod ensures that the [b]Minecraft[/b] paintings blend seamlessly into the existing art collection in Stardew Valley.
No need to worry about losing any of the original [b]Stardew Valley[/b] paintings![/size]

[size=3]This mod requires [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=3]Content Patcher[/size][/url][b].

[/b]Added 26 new paintings.

Some paintings on the wall.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/22834/22834-1713535110-1464661569.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]Relive the [b]nostalgia[/b] of your [b]Minecraft[/b] adventures while tending to your crops and raising animals in [b]Pelican Town[/b].

[/size]You can buy the new paintings on the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Bookseller]Book Seller[/url] or get for free on the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Furniture_Catalogue]Furniture Catalogue[/url].

Note: The [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Bookseller]Book Seller[/url]﻿ only sells one random painting.

::[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9158409?tab=user+files]Check out my mods[/url]::
